notes.title: 🚀"Frame Rate Surge & Construction Frenzy" – Version 2.0 Launches Now!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
We’re thrilled to deliver a ​massive overhaul that will redefine your gameplay experience!

✨ ​Visual & Performance Leap
Optimized rendering pipeline with ​up to 50% higher FPS! Even potato PCs now run smoother than ever!

💸 ​Construction Cost Revolution
Mid/late-game land prices ​reduced, building costs ​chopped – expand your empire ​twice as fast!

🖥️ ​Resolution Mastery
New ​adaptive UI system ensures perfect scaling across all screens. Full ultrawide support included!

🚀 Update now and dive into a smoother, freer, and more immersive creative journey!
Your feedback drives our next evolution – share your thoughts in the comments!

#PerformanceRevolution #BuildWithoutLimits #ScreenAdaptation

notes.title: Update：Beta-3.1 ZenMode
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45135229/6b177699b88291cb9fab921a7be29f29295daf76.png


 New addition: In the settings interface, you can check "Zen Mode". After checking, crows and lightning strikes will not occur. It is suitable for players who want to immerse themselves in idling!
 New addition: A secondary confirmation interface pops up when deleting the save file.
 Update: Better planting interaction logic. When planting crops, clicking on other buildings no longer exits the planting, and you can continue to plant crops continuously.
 Fix: BUG where tasks cannot be opened upon completion; BUGs related to save files; BUG of refreshing reward buildings;

Update beta-2.1 Enjoy The Music
notes.notes:
New feature: Environmental volume adjustment function. Now the environmental volume can be adjusted separately. The volumes of waves, rain, and thunder can be adjusted individually.
Fix: sound when place crop

notes.title: Beta-1.3 Version update, numerical adjustment
notes.notes:
Based on the valuable feedback from Beta testers, we've adjusted the numerical values of most of the content.

 The growth time of crops has been shortened.
 The value of crops has been increased.
 We've adjusted the unlocking order of buildings to optimize the early-game experience, ensuring that more useful buildings are unlocked in the early stages.

notes.title: The official version will be released soon
notes.notes: The long-awaited "Animal FarmLand" is ready to go online. In the remaining time, more tests and detail adjustments will be carried out to provide a better experience for the official version! Thank you for downloading and trying out the Demo version. The official version will be released on December 27, 2024, GMT+8
